posts.cooked:
Hi,

You have to create the script file in your home directory path(~/se2001/BPT3_problem_4). You are in /opt path. I think that’s why permission is denied.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
You are in the wrong folder. You are not allowed to create scripts in opt folder. Follow these steps :-

cd
mkdir se2001 (if you don’t have it)
cd se2001
mkdir BPT3_problem_*
cd BPT3_problem_1

here you can create the scripts and don’t forget to give chmod +x permission.
